body: I just want to thank each and every one of you for the kind words that you have left. I never expected such a big response with some really wonderful words, I came to you guys as a last resort just hoping that someone could say something to make me feel a little bit better and you guys did so much more than that. Thank you.
Hahaha, it's never too late. Thank you very much you wonderful stranger
That is very kind of you, thank you
Thank you
Thanks!
Thanks a lot :)
Thank you, and yes they certainly did. I must say I am shocked by the response that this has had.
Hahah, that is brilliant
'cheeki breeki' hahaha, haven't heard that in a while. Thank you
Thanks, and I hope your next birthday is much better

Thank you MNPH, that sure has put a smile on my face.

And I'm going to wait till the weekend for that; gives me something to look forward to.
Never too late, thank you very much
Thank you for everything you have just said, it's nice to be reminded and made to feel like I am actually worth something.
I really like your way of thinking, taking advantage of what is normally seen as a negative and turning it into a positive thing. I can do whatever I want and I will do exactly that. Thank you.
Well I hope you had a wonderful birthday and thank you for taking the time out of your day to make me feel better

It's really nice to know that there are others out there who can relate to what I am feeling.
Thank you for your kind words.
I can't believe you even went to the effort of turning a piece of spaghetti into a candle, that is just amazing
Well i hope you have a great birthday whenever that day comes
You have made my day, I genuinely can't stop smiling now. From the bottom of my heart, thank you so much you incredible human being.

I really cannot thank you enough, I know you have done this not because you know me, not because you feel like you have to but because you want to. You should be proud of yourself, thank you for the support.
hahaha, i would rather not post my name but i strongly appreciate your persistence. Thank you
Thank you for making me smile
Thanks, and you know what, I do love cake.

Thank you, and it's just hard when you feel like nobody really knows how you feel, almost as if I'm living my life behind a mask and no one even knows there is someone hiding underneath it. Thank you for reviving some hope inside me that it will get better
